evidence.description: REQ-C2 rewritten to consume params.flow via NPM_INSTALL_FLOW_MAP. 'allowlist_check' → status 'npm_install-ok-flow=allowlist_check'; unknown flow → 'npm_install-ok-flow=<F>'; missing flow → plain 'npm_install-ok'. FIND-2-001 CLOSED — flow no longer silently dropped; caller can distinguish via status suffix.

3 send_keys emitters verified: trust_dialog (keys='1', enter=True) → REQ-B1(i); api_rate_limit (keys='/model haiku-4-5', enter=True) → REQ-B1(i); cron_missing (flow='reinject_startup') → REQ-B1(ii) via SEND_KEYS_FLOW_MAP. All 3 honored deterministically; no unmapped/dropped params.

REQ-B1 EDGE-E3 covered: missing both keys and flow → 'send_keys-noop-no-params' fail-soft; unknown flow → 'send_keys-unknown-flow-<F>' fail-soft. Deterministic composition with health_check_v2 emitters.

PROP-C2-npm_install-flow-consumed added — explicitly requires status contains flow=allowlist_check when hook_missing recipe fires; missing → plain npm_install-ok; unknown → npm_install-ok-flow=<F>. Testable as tier-1 property.

PROP-B1 covers both keys and flow variants: PROP-B1-send_keys-invokes-tmux-send-keys (keys), PROP-B1-send_keys-flow-variant-mapped (flow=reinject_startup → /startup), PROP-B1-send_keys-unknown-flow-fail-soft. All 3 emitter paths from health_check_v2 have explicit proof obligations.

Purity boundary declared: I/O SHELL = execute_recipe wires (subprocess); PURE = status string construction. Group-C signature change (anicca_home kwarg) documented with fail-soft PROP-C-no-anicca-home-fail-soft.
